name: Editorial
description: Magazine-inspired editorial storytelling with a strong cover, generous whitespace, image-led pacing, and concise evidence blocks.
localized_description: 杂志化的编辑叙事体系，用强封面、宽留白和图片节奏把复杂主题讲得更有质感。

layouts.description: Full-bleed image-led cover with a protected right title column.
Large editorial statement with a single accent rule and compact metadata.
Chapter divider with oversized number, short title, and a narrow image strip.
Large image story on the left with two editorial copy columns on the right.
Oversized quote with portrait frame and a short source caption.
One evidence chart, one conclusion, and a restrained annotation rail.
Horizontal timeline with a supporting image and three narrative steps.
Full-bleed closing image with a protected question and next action zone.
